description: An unofficial, open-source YouTube client for Android. An unofficial, open-source YouTube client for Android. Features * Browse YouTube. Explore your home feed, search for videos, and browse channels, playlists, Shorts, and your library. * Play your way. Enjoy ad-free playback with controls for video quality, speed, subtitles, and audio tracks. Keep listening in the background, use picture-in-picture or the mini-player, or cast to another device. * Download for later. Save videos, audio, subtitles, or entire playlists. Choose the quality and language, and pause or resume downloads as needed. * Keep things organized. Build queues with shuffle, repeat, and autoplay. Watch history and Watch later are available even when you're signed out. * Multiple accounts, all in one. Easily switch between your anonymous account and multiple signed-in accounts. * Make it yours. Customize SponsorBlock, playback gestures, themes, and language. Enable DeArrow for alternative titles and thumbnails.
